notes.title: 2025.06.04 - Demo Version Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update Details:

The fourth commander has been added to the game and will be unlocked during the upcoming Steam Next Fest!

Buildings:

Mercenary Camp:
Previously: Instantly generates Swordsmen x3, Archer x2 upon purchase.
Now: Instantly generates Swordsmen x3, Archer x2 upon purchase and selling.
No longer generates Gold.
Cost adjusted: 200 → 300.


Relics:

AL Greatbow Reworked: 
Previously: Archers gain +100% attack range
Now: Archers gain +70% ATK per kill (permanent)
This relic effect on equipment have also been updated.
(I apologize to players who obtained equipment with this effect and to the poor defense towers that died in confusion due to this design oversight.)


Commanders:

Perlin:

Tuning Crystal: Military → Culture

Power Crystal: Military → Culture

Unstable Crystal: Culture → Military
+50% → +100% generation speed when adjacent to the 4 types of crystals

Gustav: 

Treasury:  Lv Ⅱ → Lv Ⅲ  
Cost adjusted: 800 → 1200

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where area damage incorrectly calculated armor twice.
Fixed an issue where ground melee units' area damage could hit flying units.

notes.title: 2025.05.26 - Demo Version Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update Details:

Units:

Catapult: Increased explosion radius.

Luggage: Attacks now deal AOE damage.

Duck: HP reduced from 25 => 20.

Buildings:

Wizard Kindergarten: Added generation effects and sound.

Wizarding University: Generation speed bonus per adjacent empty tile increased from 20% => 30%.

Wizarding University: Base generation speed reduced from 2.5 => 2.

Relics:

Cursed Pendant: When gaining a tile, randomly eliminates 3 => 10 enemy units.

Voodoo Doll:
Old effect: Selling a building randomly eliminates 3 enemy units.
New effect: Randomly eliminate 15 enemy units when losing a tile

Difficulty:

Brutal+: Enemy HP increase per level raised from 3% => 10% (applies only to the demo version).

Performance:

Optimized lag issues when too many projectiles (e.g., archer arrows) are present simultaneously.

UI:

Added icons for traits: Melee, Ranged, Armor-Piercing, Flying, AOE Damage.
Relics in the Codex now show their building rewards in the details panel.
Acquired relics now show their names in the details panel.
Placed buildings now indicate their type in the details panel.
Building details panels no longer display production speed values.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where players could still refresh the shop with hotkeys while the relic "Growth Elixir" is active.
Fixed an infinite healing loop when a Monk had both the "Mandrake" relic and an equipment with the same effect.

notes.title: 2025.05.10 - Demo Version Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update Details:

Increased Equipment Drop Quantity:

Hard difficulty: Drops 2 pieces of equipment.
Brutal/Brutal+ difficulties: Drops 3 pieces of equipment.
Note: Drop rates for equipment with Relic effects have been slightly reduced to balance this change.

Unit Cap Adjustments:

Allied units: Max 500 on the field.
Enemy units: Max 400 on the field.

Other Improvements:

Freshly obtained gear now has a visual indicator to help players distinguish new drops.
The amount of O.G.R.E. earned has been greatly boosted.
Bug fixes

The demo version has received a lot of feedback and bug reports. Thank you all so much for your support! More features and gameplay content are currently in active development!

New relics added:

	Mori's Arrow: Archers fire +2 additional arrows

	Fire Lance: Knights' charge attacks cause small area explosion damage
	Steel Talons: Griffins deal +200% damage to flying and ranged units
	Frost Tome: Wizards' attacks permanently reduce enemy movement speed to 0
	Holy Trumpet: Monks' healing range +150%
	Spicy Jerky: Wyrmling's burning area +150%

notes.title: 2025.04.13 - Demo Version Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update Details:

New Feature: Selectable Difficulty Levels

The demo now offers four difficulty options:
Normal
Hard
Brutal
Brutal+

New Feature: Brutal+ Mode

Progressive challenge with escalating difficulty per layer
Random enemy combinations on each layer
Each layer introduces one unique battlefield-modifying "Whim"
Enemy unit HP increases by 3% per layer
Demo version capped at 10 layers maximum

New Mechanic: Whims

Battlefield-altering effects exclusive to Brutal+ mode.
The following Whims have been implemented:
Literally ALL: Selecting a relic also grants the other two
BlackSheepWall: Start with 84 tiles
Quackocalypse: All enemy units are ducks
Rush Hour: First wave of enemies arrives 5min later
Bloodlust: Commander skill cooldown speed increased by 100%
When In Doubt: Enemy core has only 10% durability
Brickflight Protocol: Player's units gain the "Flying" tag (cannot be attacked by ground melee units)
Leonidas' Gambit: Enemy Defense Towers won't attack
Filler Design: Start with 1000 additional gold
Oh, Fine... I'll Help!: The Luggage exists for 6 minutes

Other Improvements:

	Visual polish and text revisions
	Balance adjustments
	Bug fixes

The demo version has received a lot of feedback and bug reports. Thank you all so much for your support! More features and gameplay content are currently in active development!

notes.content:

Added: Special Thanks

New Mechanic: Relic Reroll

	Spend gold to reroll relics
	Each reroll permanently doubles the reroll cost

notes.title: 2025.04.01 - Demo Version Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update Details:

1. Fixed a data overflow issue when holding excessive amounts of gold.

2. Fixed an issue where unit attack range and other values would incorrectly scale by 10x under certain system language settings.

(I’ve fixed it in the code, but I can’t test it across all system languages. If the issue persists, please report it in the Steam discussion forum.)

3. Fixed a calculation error in the Brokerage’s bonus when no buildings are present on the left side.

4. Fixed an issue where the Brokerage’s production speed bonus wouldn’t update immediately when the game was paused.

5. Increased the Brokerage’s price to 1000.

6. Reduced the gold reward from purchasing the Black Market to 250.

7. Increased the durability of Financial Nova to 2500.

The demo version has received a lot of feedback and bug reports. Thank you all so much for your support! More features and gameplay content are currently in active development!

notes.title: 2025.02.26 - Demo Version Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update Details:


1. New Mechanic: Luggage
When one of your buildings is destroyed for the first time in a game, a Luggage will appear to guard your territory and strike down enemies.

2. The durability of the enemy core has been decreased from 50,000 to 30,000.

3. The camera movement speed while dragging with the right mouse button has been lowered.

4. The font size of floating text for production and damage has been increased for better visibility.

5. A bug where the relic "Promotional Ad" caused buildings to be unplaceable has been fixed.

The demo version has received a lot of feedback and bug reports. Thank you all so much for your support! I will continue to release optimizations and bug-fix patches in the future!
